title: Milk of Amnesia Non-Alcoholic
description: Tropical escapism in every sip—for when alcohol doesn't fit the schedule.

blocks.html: Sometimes you just want to hit pause — switch off the notifications, forget about deadlines for a while, and escape somewhere far away, where the sound of traffic is replaced by the ocean. That spirit of escape inspired Milk of Amnesia, a beer first created in 2018 and destined to become one of Gletcher Brewery’s most distinctive releases.

Milk of Amnesia began as a bold collaboration between Gletcher Brewery and the British troublemakers at Anarchy Brew Co. The result was a full-bodied, juicy and unapologetically expressive Milkshake IPA.

Its name — Milk of Amnesia — is a playful reference to medical slang associated with anaesthesia. Our version works rather differently, though: instead of switching you off, it is designed to help you leave the unnecessary stress behind and simply enjoy the moment.

Modern life rarely slows down. Driving, training, work, meetings and everyday responsibilities often mean that alcohol simply does not fit into the schedule.

But that should not mean giving up the flavour and character of craft beer.

Milk of Amnesia Non-Alcoholic retains the rich body and powerful aromatic profile that made the original beer so memorable, while removing the alcohol. A carefully controlled dealcoholisation process allows us to preserve the character of the beer and create a genuinely full-flavoured non-alcoholic alternative.

The character of Milk of Amnesia comes from an unusual balance of tropical fruit, creamy texture and expressive hops.

Natural pineapple, mango and passion fruit juices provide a bright tropical foundation, while lactose gives the beer its characteristic smooth, milkshake-like body.

Four hop varieties — Nugget, Columbus, Centennial and Mosaic — add layers of bitterness, citrus and hop aroma, keeping the sweetness in balance and giving the beer a fresh, lively finish.

Milk of Amnesia Non-Alcoholic is made for those who want to stay clear-headed without compromising on flavour.

Think of it as your personal ticket to the tropics — one you can use even in the middle of a working day.

Forget the boredom. Remember the flavour.
